note: Weight precision recipes for the resident LTX-2.5 backend, diffusers layout (Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers). Memory figures are GiB estimates (measured: false) until worker/scripts/benchmark_ltx_quantized.py measures them on the class; they are not part of the weights digest. No per-file SHA-256 is pinned: LTX-2.5 is gated and Hugging Face shows none (checked 2026-09-14), so the owner publishes kuno-devkit weights-digest output in the manifest instead. `include` names everything the loaded pipeline reads, so all of it is hashed: `processor` holds the prompt enhancer's chat template and tokenizer, which shape the text it writes as much as its weights do.

memory.basis: Measured 2026-09-16 on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (94.97 GiB), bf16, no offload, PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True. Weights, as loaded: transformer 35.37, text encoder 22.28, prompt enhancer 9.51, other 8.53 (connectors 5.91, VAE, audio VAE and vocoder 1.69, latent upsampler by difference from the 75.68 GiB total, rounded up); with the enhancer kept in host RAM a render has 66.18 GiB of weights on the GPU. Torch peak allocated, as activations over the weights on the GPU: enhancer on the GPU, 86.89 GiB at 14,080 full-size latent tokens (720p 5 s, 11.21) and 93.68 GiB at 32,560 (720p 12 s, 18.00); enhancer in host RAM, 90.0 GiB at 43,120 (720p 16 s, 23.82) and 93.87 GiB at 51,000 (1080p 8 s, 27.69); 720p 20 s (53,680) ran out of memory. The line is set conservatively: with the planner's 1.5 GiB overhead it is at or above all four measured peaks, it admits the largest measured fit (1080p 8 s) with the 0.5 GiB reserve on this card and refuses anything above 51,021 tokens, so 720p 19 s (51,040, unmeasured) and 20 s are refused. A line through the two evicted peaks alone (2.64 + 4.911 per 10k) would refuse 1080p 8 s once the overhead is added; this one has the largest slope that keeps the 5 s peak covered. Text generation adds a KV cache of 0.12 GiB for E2B at 2,048 tokens (research/director-design_2026-09-16.md §10)

weights as measured for the distilled bf16 recipe (transformer_full has the same 22B bf16 parameter count). Activations: at least the distilled recipe's measured line; classifier-free guidance runs a batch of two, which needs more, unmeasured. The earlier guess (2.0 + 3.2 per 10k) was below what the distilled pipeline measured

weights as measured for the distilled bf16 recipe, plus 3.36 GiB assumed for the temporal upsampler and diffusion decoder (sizes unknown); activation terms are unmeasured guesses, 4K decode is the peak

transformer assumed equal to the 8-bit int8-convrot build's measured 20.03 GiB resident (runaihome); SGLang documents 18.11 GB for its FP8 LTX-2.5 transformer. Text encoder stays bf16 and is offloaded while the transformer runs.; prompt enhancer and other (connectors, VAEs, vocoder, upsampler) as measured in bf16 on 2026-09-16, and the activation terms are the bf16 recipe's refit of that day's four RTX PRO 6000 peaks (activations run in bf16 whatever the weights' storage), not measured on this class. The refit raised the group-offload estimate at 720p 16 s by 3.7 GiB, which is why its limits shrank again
